C6 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
The EC ceiling is an UPPER bound on physics, not a measurement of any physics
method. A method that computed barriers directly could in principle beat it by
resolving what the EC number pools -- different substrates, isoforms, conditions.
Nothing here tried, and C5 could not test it.
BRENDA-derived kcat values carry assay heterogeneity: temperature, pH, buffer and
construct all vary and none is controlled here. That inflates C2 and C3's spread
by an unknown amount, so both are pessimistic about the ceiling.
C4 bounds that inflation from the other side but does not remove it: fixing the
organism does not fix the assay.
A rate being unpredictable does not make it NEEDED. Loop 156 measured growth-rate
sensitivity to median kcat at 0.0034 against 0.9966 for ribosome elongation, so an
aggregate can be right while every rate in it is wrong.
